- Machine Learning — Teaching computers to learn patterns from data.
  - Linear Algebra — Study of vectors, matrices, and linear transformations.
    - Vectors — Ordered lists of numbers representing data points.
    - Matrices — Rectangular arrays of numbers used for linear transformations.
    - Matrix Multiplication — Combining matrices to transform data or compose operations.
    - Eigen Decomposition — Breaking a matrix into eigenvectors and eigenvalues.
  - Probability and Statistics — Mathematical framework for uncertainty and data analysis.
    - Probability Distributions — Functions describing the likelihood of different outcomes.
    - Bayes Theorem — Updating probabilities using new evidence and priors.
    - Hypothesis Testing — Using sample data to evaluate claims about populations.
  - Supervised Learning — Learning to predict outputs from labelled input data.
    - Linear Regression — Predicting continuous values using a linear relationship.
    - Logistic Regression — Classifying data using a sigmoid output function.
    - Decision Trees — Splitting data by features to make predictions.
    - Random Forest — Ensemble of decision trees that reduces overfitting.
    - Gradient Boosting — Sequentially adding models to correct previous errors.
    - Support Vector Machines — Finding the optimal boundary separating different classes.
    - K-Nearest Neighbors — Classifying points based on their closest training examples.
  - Unsupervised Learning — Finding hidden structure in unlabelled data.
    - K-Means Clustering — Grouping data into k clusters by centroid distance.
    - Principal Component Analysis — Reducing dimensions while preserving maximum variance.
    - Hierarchical Clustering — Building a tree of nested clusters from data.
  - Model Evaluation — Assessing how well models generalize to new data.
    - Train-Test Split — Dividing data into training and evaluation sets.
    - Cross-Validation — Rotating data folds to estimate generalization error.
    - Precision and Recall — Metrics for evaluating classification performance on imbalanced data.
    - ROC AUC — Measuring ranking ability across classification thresholds.
    - Bias-Variance Tradeoff — Balancing model underfitting and overfitting.
  - Deep Learning — Multi-layered neural networks for complex pattern recognition.
    - Neural Networks — Layers of interconnected neurons learning data representations.
    - Backpropagation — Computing gradients through a network using the chain rule.
    - Convolutional Neural Networks — Processing grid-like data such as images with filters.
    - Recurrent Neural Networks — Handling sequential data using internal memory states.
  - ML Engineering — Building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning systems.
    - Feature Engineering — Creating input variables that improve model performance.
    - Hyperparameter Tuning — Searching for optimal model configuration settings.
    - Model Deployment — Serving trained models to production applications.
    - MLOps — Automating machine learning workflows and monitoring.
